source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Why does training measure performance against an objective before updating model parameters?

options.text: The measurement determines which tool permissions the model needs
options.feedback: Tool permissions constrain external operations. Training measurements instead support learning updates to the model's parameters.

options.text: The measurement certifies the truth of future generated claims
options.feedback: A learning objective guides training, but success at prediction does not verify every learned association or guarantee future accuracy.

options.text: The measured error helps guide parameter adjustments
options.feedback: Training measures performance and computes how parameters affect the error. Those results support updates to learned weights.

options.text: The measurement replaces the need to change any learned values
options.feedback: Evaluating performance supplies information for learning. Training also uses that information to update parameters; evaluation alone is not that update.
